title: Andy Hall's article supporting the chemical-plant hypothesis

tellings.quote: And he wrote a huge not a paper but a post on his website um basically an article um uh exposing the virtues of my work and corroborating why they are chemical manufacturing facilities that are powered by Earth's electricity.

plain: A writer named Andy Hall published a long post on his website backing the idea that the pyramids were chemical manufacturing plants powered by Earth's own electricity, according to Geoffrey Drumm, the man who came up with that idea. Drumm tells Michels that Hall's article, which he connects with the Thunderbolts Project, a group that stresses electricity's role in nature, set out "the virtues of my work" and backed his case. For Drumm it means another researcher has independently supported his theory.
